name: Return to Jitters
label: Quest
description: At Raven Hill, you bring Jitters a meal from Chef Grual. The cakes finally satisfy the hermit's desperate hunger.

clips.title: The story
paras: At Raven Hill, you bring Jitters a meal from Chef Grual. The cakes finally satisfy the hermit's desperate hunger.

Chef Grual cooks at the Scarlet Raven Tavern, where Duskwood's lack of livestock and sea life leaves him to use what the blighted forest provides. His specialty, Dusky Crab Cakes, contain no crab meat. Instead, Grual uses gooey legs from venom web spiders that creep through the wood. He calls it resourceful cooking; delicate stomachs may disagree.

At Raven Hill, Jitters huddles in fear, unable to face whatever horrors drove him from the woods. Terror keeps him from hunting or foraging, and hunger deepens his distress. The warm cakes bring a rare moment of relief to the trembling vagrant. Desperate for food, he eats without asking what kind of crab Grual used.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: And here we are - "Crab" Cakes ala Grual!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, you're here! Do you have my food?!?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Aha! Thank you, friend. Those really hit the spot!
And here, please let me pay you for these!
